responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s core library of known-function models for builtins and common C/POSIX APIs. It defines semantics for allocation, deallocation, memory and string routines, errno access, error-reporting exits, sanitizer hooks, varargs support, and other special calls, updating region_model state, emitting bifurcated call outcomes via call_info when needed, and registering these handlers with known_function_manager so the engine can model calls without entering their bodies.
